summary: Lists requirements for a way to mark SIP messages so they get logged. Operators debugging customer problems often cannot predict which networks a call crosses, so end-to-end monitoring is hard. A marker on the message would flag it as a candidate for logging, usually during operator-controlled testing. This is a requirements document, not a protocol.

eli5.summary: When a package gets lost, it helps if the sender puts a bright sticker on it that tells every post office to write down where it went.

questions: how to mark sip messages for logging
